what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Kenya, as counted by IDMC.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 10362 people living in internal displacement because of conflict and violence; UNHCR reports no figure above zero for that year.
Refugees from Kenya live mostly in Ethiopia, Canada and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Northeastern Province and Coast territory in Kenya with Al-Shabaab from 2015 to 2025.
Floods and mass movements are the disasters recorded for Kenya in IDMC's data.

when.text: IDMC's figures rose from 250000 in 2009 to 412000 in 2013, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2015.
The figure was much lower by the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say where displaced people are living or which routes they took.
IDMC also counts new displacements in each year, which count movements, not people, so someone forced to move twice is counted twice.
